query_text: Imagine that instead of presidential debates, we had rap battles. Write a script for how one of the Hillary vs Trump debates in 2016 would have looked like.

message.content:
I'll write a rap battle script based on the actual 2016 debate moments and themes. Here's how a Hillary vs. Trump debate might have looked as a rap battle:

---

# **2016 PRESIDENTIAL RAP BATTLE**
## **Hillary Clinton vs. Donald Trump**

---

**[DJ drops beat - dramatic orchestral hip-hop instrumental]**

**MODERATOR (Anderson Cooper):**
Ladies and gentlemen, welcome to the first presidential rap battle of 2016! In this corner, former Secretary of State, the First Lady of Flow—HILLARY RODHAM CLINTON! And in this corner, businessman, reality TV star, the Donald himself—DONALD J. TRUMP! You each have 60 seconds. Hillary, you won the coin toss. Drop that beat!

---

**HILLARY CLINTON:**
*(adjusts pantsuit, steps to mic)*

Listen here, Donnie, let me make this clear,
I've been in the West Wing while you were wrestling, dear.
You got skin like Russian dressing, too much Russian investing,
Your tax returns are hiding—what you really got's depressing!

I was fighting for healthcare while you were filing bankruptcies,
Built a empire on scams and fake universities.
You call women pigs, dogs, slobs—disgusting,
But I'm 3-0 in debates, watch your campaign combusting!

You bring Bill's accusers? That's your big attack?
I stood by my man—something your wives can't say back!
You want to talk emails? I deleted some threads,
You deleted three marriages and common sense from your head!

I'm the most qualified candidate ever to run,
You're a Twitter troll with a spray tan and a son
Who kills elephants for fun—you're the real disaster,
November 8th, Donnie, I'm the first female master!

---

**DONALD TRUMP:**
*(gold mic, aggressive posture)*

WRONG! Let me just say, I respect all females,
But your rhymes are trash, put 'em next to your emails!
Crooked Hillary, lock her up, that's the crowd's demand,
I built a wall of support you could never understand!

My rallies are YUGE, bigger than you've ever seen,
While you're collapsing into vans in 9/11 scenes!
You got stamina? Please, you can barely stand,
I'm up at 3 AM, tweeting, making America grand!

You were Secretary of State, what did you accomplish?
Libya's a disaster, ISIS on the march, it's
A total catastrophe, you're the mother of ISIS,
I'm the law and order candidate—my rhymes are the nicest!

You want open borders, let everybody in,
I say America first, let the winning begin!
You're a nasty woman, puppet of the establishment,
I'm self-funding, baby—total disestablishment!

---

**HILLARY CLINTON:**
*(laughing, shaking head)*

"Self-funding"? Donnie, you started with daddy's millions,
You're a small loan of a million dollars—feelings!
You stiff your contractors, won't release your taxes,
Got a billion dollar loss—now THAT'S losing in practice!

You say "believe me" but you lie every minute,
PolitiFact checked you—Pants on Fire, you're in it!
You mocked a disabled reporter, attacked a Gold Star family,
You're temperamentally unfit, that's not hyperbole, frankly!

---

**DONALD TRUMP:**
*(interrupting)*

Such a nasty woman! Always with the complaints,
I know words, I have the best words—check my constraints!
You got 30 years, what have you done? Nothing!
I'm the outsider, the change agent, the real something!

You called half my supporters a basket of deplorables,
I'll call you what you are: totally unadorable!
No puppet, no puppet—YOU'RE the puppet, it's true,
Of Goldman Sachs, the banks, the elite crew!

---

**HILLARY CLINTON:**
*(calm, measured)*

At least I pay my taxes, at least I don't grope,
At least when I speak, I don't sound like a dope.
You said "grab 'em by the"—I won't repeat that filth,
You're unfit for office, a stain on our nation's wealth.

---

**DONALD TRUMP:**
*(leaning into mic)*

Bill Clinton was abusive to women, Hillary attacked them,
Brought them to the debate, front row, I stacked them!
You want to talk about treatment of the fairer sex?
Your husband's in the hall—go ask him what comes next!

---

**[Suddenly, ABRAHAM LINCOLN descends from ceiling on a bald eagle]**

**ABRAHAM LINCOLN:**
*(top hat, beard, holding axe)*

Excuse me, both of you, this is ridiculous spit,
I'm the greatest president ever, so I'm ending this skit!
You with the pantsuit, don't let hired be your peak,
And you, orange baby, democracy's looking weak!

This government of the people, by the people, for the people,
Is not for reality stars acting like they're equals!
Now I'm going back to my memorial to rest,
You two keep debating—whoever sucks less!

---

**[Lincoln exits on eagle. Beat drops out. Moderator steps in.]**

**MODERATOR:**
And that's time! Audience, make some noise for... actually, please don't riot. We'll be right back after these messages from our sponsors. Remember to vote—if Trump accepts the results!

**[End scene]**

---

Sources:
1. https://globalnews.ca/news/3051825/donald-trump-vs-hillary-clinton-the-most-memorable-cringe-worthy-moments-from-the-2016-campaign/
2. https://www.goldderby.com/tv/2016/donald-trump-vs-hillary-clinton-epic-rap-battles-of-history/
3. https://globalnews.ca/news/3015351/presidential-debate-2016-what-donald-trump-and-hillary-clinton-said-on-iraq-syria-and-mexico/
4. https://mashable.com/video/epic-rap-battles-of-history-donald-trump-hillary-clinton
5. https://epicrapbattlesofhistory.fandom.com/wiki/Donald_Trump_vs_Kamala_Harris
